name: Shinnecock Hills Golf Club
architects: William Flynn (Toomey & Flynn, 1931; built by Dick Wilson)
C. B. Macdonald and Seth Raynor (1916)
renovations: Toomey & Flynn new course 1928-31 after Route 27 cut the old one (7th Redan of 1916 kept)
Coore & Crenshaw restoration 2012 (Golf Club Atlas; Wikipedia infobox 2013): trees removed, fairways widened, fescue rough restored, some greens enlarged
lengthened to 7,440 yd for the 2018 US Open
2026 US Open: fairway mowing lines moved out toward the bunkers; same length
notable: US Open and US Women's Open 2036
USGA founding club; 1892 McKim, Mead & White clubhouse
video_games: PGA Tour 2K25 (licensed, Season 6 patch 15 April 2026, 126th US Open course, free; MyCAREER event course). Fan-made Links 2003 add-on 'Shinnecock Hills HD Tournament Edition' (Robert Miller, 2011). Not in EA Sports PGA Tour.
tees_note: Men's Red/Green/Blue from GolfPass/GolfNow (Green per-hole total prints 6,430); women's Blue and men's White from Stymie (a different card version: Blue 6,122, White 5,394); GolfPass's White 72.5/131 matches Stymie's women's White
special_ground: about 100 acres of native rough: fescues and little bluestem (rough_band_m ~2-3, fescue beyond)
sandy blowouts outside the bunkers: surface 18 waste
water: almost none: the 6th ('Pond') has a pond to check in OSM/ortho; red by default

lidar.bare_earth: NYS DEM_2024_Long_Island (1 m; shared download in docs/scouting/ngla/DATA_REQUEST.md); 3DEP fallback, project name not confirmed (tiles x71y453, x71y454)
lidar.canopy: NYS Long Island 2024 LAS tiles (shared), class 1 = vegetation and structures; fallback NOAA DAV 4938

imagery: NYS orthoimagery wms/Latest, 0.5 m (shared); NAIP fallback
scorecard_status: third-party per-hole card (GolfPass: 4 tees, pars, men's and women's stroke index); conflicting Stymie version; US Open 2018 and 2026 yardages; no official card online
open_questions: theme coastal instead of bayside (rec: coastal)
